details:
ORBIT-X – Project Details

ORBIT-X is an interactive space mission simulator created to make space exploration more engaging and accessible to students. It allows users to explore destinations such as Earth, the Moon, and Mars, design spacecraft, manage fuel and mass, analyze mission conditions, and experience simulated launch sequences.

The project combines interactive gameplay, space engineering concepts, and 3D visualization to help users understand the basic challenges involved in planning a space mission. Users can experiment with different spacecraft configurations and observe simulated mission outcomes.

ORBIT-X was developed using React, JavaScript, Vite, CSS, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and other supporting libraries. The application includes mission design, mission analysis, telemetry, mission guidance, and an interactive space pilot game.

The project aims to encourage curiosity about space science, improve understanding of spacecraft systems, and make learning about space missions more enjoyable. Future improvements could include more realistic orbital calculations, additional NASA datasets, advanced mission scenarios, and multiplayer mission challenges.

ORBIT-X is an educational simulation and does not represent a real spacecraft mission or official NASA software.
